ammo_box._doc: Ammo boxes (Update 02 section 4, T-049): hold use to refill the weapon in hand (mag + reserve) and lethal grenades (not tacticals). Price by what you hold: normal / Crucible-upgraded, wonder weapons (class wonder) wonder / wonder_upgraded. grenades_only = the price when the gun is full but grenades are short (or nothing is held). cooldown_s = per player, after a purchase.
